links.comparator_used: Unwatermarked LLM-generated medical text (implied baseline; the abstract does not name it)
links.outcome: Medical factual accuracy and coherence of watermarked text, summarised in the Factuality-Weighted Score
links.effect: Watermarking methods 'substantially compromise medical factuality'; the abstract reports no numeric values.
links.tradeoff: Watermarking reweights low-entropy tokens that carry medical terminology. This degrades medical entity representation and risks inaccuracy and hallucinations.
links.quote: Our evaluation shows current watermarking methods substantially compromise medical factuality, with entropy shifts degrading medical entity representation.
